summary.text: Kevin Grover is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Jeff Martin.
He is a retired education administrator.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Grover was born in Kansas City, Missouri.
He earned a diploma from Blue Springs High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri, Columbia, in 1991, and a graduate degree from Northwest Missouri State University in 1999.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Grover said he retired from education in July 2023 after thirty-one years, including seven years as a high school science teacher and coach and twenty-four years as a secondary school administrator.
He said he is a co-pastor at his church and that he and his wife, Janné, have three children.

In the same survey, Grover listed fully funding the school foundation formula, supporting universal early childhood education, expanding Medicaid and supporting workers' wages and benefits among his priorities.
